value.description: An agent-proposed change to an issue that a maintainer can approve or dismiss.

actor_id.description: The unique identifier of the actor that proposed the suggestion.

confidence.description: The actor's confidence level in the suggestion.

created_at.description: The time the suggestion was created.

id.description: The unique identifier of the suggestion.

issue_event_id.description: The identifier of the timeline event created when the suggestion was approved, when applicable.

issue_id.description: The unique identifier of the issue the suggestion applies to.

rationale.description: The rationale the actor provided for the suggestion.

resolved_by.description: The unique identifier of the user who approved or dismissed the suggestion.

target_id.description: The identifier of the target the change applies to (issue type, label, field, assignee, or duplicate issue), when applicable.

target_value.description: The proposed value, when applicable. An array for multi-select field suggestions.

updated_at.description: The time the suggestion was last updated.

value.title: Issue Suggestion
